files.description: Comprehensive tests for the cluster-based face assignment page (/faces): quick person creation, assigning a single face via the sidebar searchable select, similarity auto-matching to people, similarity clustering, keyboard-shortcut assignment, and the per-cluster pager / skip-cluster navigation. Runs in serial mode because the tests share one server-side pool of unassigned faces. Adds a 'Face Assignment — responsive' describe (P3) covering the page's own narrow-screen behaviour: the contract width matrix plus 844x390, the faces-actions and faces-filters peer-panel contracts and their declaration order with the Menu toggle last, the server-rendered applied-filter badge, filter/in-progress-edit survival across a resize through the breakpoint, the Group by radio row layout, the cluster pager collapsing to one row of 44px icon controls at 320px, the phone preview remaining viewport-fixed and centered across scroll positions plus anchored tablet-touch and desktop-hover popovers, shortcut reordering through both the explicit move controls and a real emulated touch drag, and the help dialog's contained scrolling.

testContext: The /faces page groups unassigned faces into .suggestion-group clusters rendered server-side, but the .face thumbnails inside are painted CLIENT-SIDE into the active group's .grid only — one cluster is visible at a time (others have [hidden]); each group's full face list lives in its data-faces JSON attribute (entries: {id, photo_date, similarity}). All faces of the active cluster start SELECTED (selectedIds = whole cluster); deselect via the .cluster-select-all, then click individual .face[data-face-id] elements. Assigning or skipping advances to the next cluster or reloads for the next batch. Use URL params (/faces?group_by=similarity&threshold=2 or group_by=people) instead of driving the radio+slider UI. Clusters from DBSCAN have >= 3 faces (min_samples=3); people-mode groups are named after the person (.cluster-name) and carry .assign-group-btn[data-person-name] buttons; unmatched faces land in an 'Unknown' group with null similarity. The sidebar person select (#sidebar-person-select) is a hidden searchable-select — click `#sidebar-person-select + .searchable-select-wrapper .searchable-select-display` then a .searchable-select-option. Keyboard shortcuts (number keys) are rebuilt per cluster into #sidebar-shortcut-people .shortcut-item elements. CRITICAL: POST /api/faces/assign only marks faces PROCESSING and enqueues a background task on the yaffo taskq — the isolated sandbox must run `python -m yaffo.taskq.host` (isolated_runner.ts spawns it since 2026-07-01) and tests must poll the person's /people/{id}/faces page ([data-face-id]) for completion instead of expecting immediate assignment. Person deletion goes through the global confirm dialog (#confirm-dialog-confirm) and returns the person's faces to the unassigned pool, which is how afterEach restores state. People list rows link via a.person-name.row-link to /people/{id}/faces; delete links are a.action-link.delete. Creating a person via the quick action reloads the page ~1.5s after the 201 response, so assert on the repopulated #sidebar-person-select options rather than the transient toast. Playwright's global 5s timeout is too tight for these flows; the describe block overrides it (30s) and uses serial mode. Responsive additions (2026-08-30): shared assertions come from generated_tests/_support/responsive.ts (expectRouteFits, expectNoPageOverflow, expectFitsViewport, expectPanelContract, withTouchContext, touchDrag, CONTRACT_WIDTHS, VIEWPORTS). The page registers two panels, #faces-actions and #faces-filters, whose peer buttons are #faces-actions-toggle and #faces-filters-toggle; the Menu button is #nav-menu-toggle and carries NO data-nav-panel-toggle attribute, so any ordering assertion has to select '[data-nav-panel-toggle], #nav-menu-toggle'. applied_filter_count counts group_by and threshold, so /faces?group_by=similarity&threshold=2 renders a '2' badge. The per-cluster pager now uses the shared pagination markup (data-icon + .page-btn-label), so the labels are hidden and the buttons are 44px squares at <=640px. The shortcut dialog's rows are reordered with Pointer Events plus .shortcut-config-move-btn[data-move=up|down] buttons — HTML5 drag-and-drop is gone, because touch never fires it.
explanation: 2026-07-01: Rewritten for the redesigned cluster-based faces page and the async taskq pipeline. The old page's flat face grid, #deselect-all button, page-size pagination and #deleteModal are gone; hardcoded OBAMA_FACE_IDS from the dlib era were dropped (InsightFace reseed changed face ids) in favor of asserting positive similarity scores in the matched group's data-faces payload. Assignment verification now polls /people/{id}/faces because /api/faces/assign completes in a background worker. All 6 tests pass against the isolated sandbox (twice in a row, confirming cleanup restores the shared face pool). 2026-08-30 (P3, responsive rollout): hand-written responsive scenarios added — not generated and not healed. Two page bugs were found and fixed while writing them and each has a scenario naming the cause: the cluster pager rendered five full-text buttons that could not share a row at 320px, and the shortcut list's reordering was HTML5 drag-and-drop, which produces no events at all for touch. Full file green (18/18) via `npm run test:spec -- generated_tests/face_assignment/face-assignment.spec.ts --port 5302`. The 2026-09-04 iPhone SE regression adds icon-only 44px navbar peers at widths up to 400px, with explicit accessible names and a contained filter-count badge. The face source preview now uses a centered modal only through the 640px phone breakpoint, an explicit-control popover on touch tablets, and a hover popover on fine-pointer desktops.
